gabarito_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(total_compensations > 0, nk_customer_id, NULL)) AS clientes_ativos_mdr FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_actual` WHERE nk_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
_origem: Looker dashboard 1180 (tile 'Ativacao MDR - Clientes ativos & ARPU', measure clientes_ativos_mdr) + Glossario 'Clientes Ativos (MDR)': clientes com >=1 transacao compensada/liquidada -> contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_actual (COUNT DISTINCT nk_customer_id com total_compensations>0).

gabarito_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sum_of_revenue_ca) / COUNT(DISTINCT IF(total_compensations > 0, nk_customer_id, NULL)), 2) AS arpu_mdr FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_actual` WHERE nk_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
_origem: Looker dashboard 1180 (tile 'Ativacao MDR - Clientes ativos & ARPU', measure arpu_mdr) + Glossario 'ARPU': soma da receita total / qtd de clientes ativos -> contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_actual (Receita MDR total / Clientes Ativos MDR no mes).

gabarito_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(sum_of_amount_paid), 2) AS tpv_payments FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_track_backend` WHERE nk_acquit_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
_origem: Glossario 'TPV' (Looker Payments > TPV): volume total de pagamentos processados pela Conta Azul -> contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_track_backend (SUM de sum_of_amount_paid sobre nk_acquit_date = pagamentos liquidados no mes).

gabarito_sql: SELECT SUM(sum_of_revenue_ca) / SUM(sum_of_amount_paid) AS take_rate FROM `contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_track_backend` WHERE nk_acquit_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
_origem: Glossario 'Take Rate' (Looker Payments > Take Rate): valor financeiro arrecadado sobre o processamento de pagamentos -> contaazul-ssbi.gold_mdr.fact_track_backend (SUM sum_of_revenue_ca / SUM sum_of_amount_paid sobre nk_acquit_date no mes; razao 0-1, sem multiplicar por 100).
